app_access.notes: Play Games sign-in is user initiated from an eligible result screen; lessons, decks, games, and local progress remain usable while signed out.

target_audience_draft.basis: The product is a reading-intensive Korean typing and TOPIK learning tool, is not marketed to children, and has no child-directed characters, ads, social feed, or account system.

content_rating_draft.notes: Play Games exposes scores and achievements but the app has no chat, public profile editor, social feed, or public user-deck upload. Confirm the current IARC wording in Console before submission.

off_device_boundaries.trigger: App launch refresh and official deck download
off_device_boundaries.payload: HTTP request metadata plus catalog/deck resource path; no learning record or personal deck content
off_device_boundaries.final_declaration: Confirm the selected production host's IP/log retention and service-provider terms before answering Data safety.

off_device_boundaries.trigger: Foreground product and purchase-state query, purchase, or restore
off_device_boundaries.payload: Google Play product and purchase transaction data; the app retains only entitlement state and purchase-token handling locally and has no receipt server
off_device_boundaries.final_declaration: Apply Google Play's payment-processing exception only if the final integration meets every condition in the Data safety instructions.

off_device_boundaries.trigger: Configured build checks authentication; sign-in and leaderboard opening are user initiated; eligible local scores and achievements sync when authenticated
off_device_boundaries.payload: Play Games player authentication state, eligible score values, and achievement progress
off_device_boundaries.final_declaration: Review the SDK Index/provider disclosure for the exact shipped SDK and declare all SDK collection or sharing required by the current form.

off_device_boundaries.trigger: User opens feedback, support, or privacy
off_device_boundaries.payload: Feedback draft may contain app version, language, screen source, and official deck ID; the user reviews and sends it outside PIYOKEY
off_device_boundaries.final_declaration: Treat as a user-initiated external action and keep the public privacy notice aligned.

security_answers.local_data_deletion: Android clear-storage or uninstall, plus in-app user-deck delete/export flows
